headline: Sensex Surges 1,000 Points as Nifty Tops 23,300 Led by Reliance and Oil & Gas Stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex rallied over 1,000 points and Nifty crossed 23,300, adding substantial market capitalization on D-Street.
Reliance Industries and strong auto sales data lifted overall market sentiment.
Nifty Oil & Gas index registered strong buying, gaining over 3%.
Positive earnings reactions in key companies like NTPC and Jio Platforms buoyed investor optimism.
whatHappening: Sensex surged to intraday highs around 1,000+ points while Nifty 50 moved above 23,350.
NTPC shares gained 3% after Q2 earnings with analysts at Jefferies and Nuvama remaining bullish.
Jio Platforms reported a 14% YoY increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 8,389 crore, pushing shares up over 3%.
FII selling pressure persists as almost every second Nifty stock saw institutional stake cuts across 2026.
summary:
Indian markets surged on Monday with the Sensex jumping over 1,000 points and Nifty moving above 23,300.
The rally was driven by gains in Reliance Industries, auto sales sentiment, and a 3% surge in Nifty Oil & Gas.
Key stock movers included NTPC, Tata Steel, Max Healthcare, and Reliance following positive corporate developments.
